title: BLOCKED: engine enforcement rejects Node 22
scenario: pnpm typecheck; pnpm lint; pnpm test; pnpm build; pnpm contract:check
actual: ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE: Expected version: >=24.21.0 <25; Got: v22.23.3. All five unmodified pnpm commands exit 1 before checks. Environment-only overrides still fail in nested pnpm.
evidence: ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE: Expected version: >=24.21.0 <25; Got: v22.23.3. All five unmodified pnpm commands exit 1 before checks. Environment-only overrides still fail in nested pnpm.
suggested_fix: Use direct expanded commands with --config.engine-strict=false; use the supported Node version for release evidence.
repro_test: pnpm typecheck; pnpm lint; pnpm test; pnpm build; pnpm contract:check

title: Invocation error: two unittest modules require discovery
scenario: python3 -m unittest scripts.test_guardrails -v; python3 -m unittest scripts.test_scope -v
actual: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'validate_blueprint'; scripts/test_scope.py:8 similarly cannot import 'check_scope'. Each initial module invocation exits 1 with one loader error, zero real tests executed.
evidence: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'validate_blueprint'; scripts/test_scope.py:8 similarly cannot import 'check_scope'. Each initial module invocation exits 1 with one loader error, zero real tests executed.
suggested_fix: Use unittest discover -s scripts -p test_guardrails.py -v and the equivalent test_scope.py invocation. Guardrails rerun passes; scope result recorded separately.
repro_test: python3 -m unittest scripts.test_guardrails -v; python3 -m unittest scripts.test_scope -v

title: BLOCKED: host directories invalidate copied scope fixture
actual: Discovery run exits 1: 11 passed, 1 failed. AssertionError: ['inventory: unlisted top-level entry .aws', 'inventory: unlisted top-level entry .codex'] != []. The fixture copies host directories without .git, triggering filesystem-list fallback; the real repository scope check passes.
evidence: Discovery run exits 1: 11 passed, 1 failed. AssertionError: ['inventory: unlisted top-level entry .aws', 'inventory: unlisted top-level entry .codex'] != []. The fixture copies host directories without .git, triggering filesystem-list fallback; the real repository scope check passes.
suggested_fix: Rerun in a clean checkout without host-injected directories; consider excluding ignored host directories from test fixture copies. Do not inspect or publish their contents.
